reviewItem.question: Does "RSA Certificate Compliance: The United States Department of Defense published a memo: Department of Defense Transition to Stronger Public Key Infrastructure…" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cert-manager|name=rsa-signature-hash-algorithm (behavior-changed)?

change.before: "SHA-256 always used when signing with RSA"
change.after: "3072-bit keys use SHA-384, 4096-bit keys use SHA-512"

proposed.statement: From v1.17.0 cert-manager picks the RSA signing hash by key length (3072-bit uses SHA-384, 4096-bit uses SHA-512) instead of always using SHA-256.
